title: DOE-UAP-D005, Pantex Unidentified Object Incident Report, 2015
doc_notes: This is an official Department of Energy incident report regarding an unidentified aerial object observed over the Pantex facility, and it contains detailed encounter descriptions from security personnel.

encounters.summary: Protective Force personnel observed and tracked an unidentified object over the Pantex plant, describing it as a diamond-shaped or small, thin object that moved silently at low altitude.
encounters.entity_appearance: Diamond type shape, round at the top, or 4 ft tall and 2 ft wide at the bottom, thinner at the top; colors reported as black, or silver, red and blue.
encounters.entity_behavior: Traveled at 10-15 mph, silent, increased speed and changed direction when followed.
encounters.quote: Their perspective of the object was that it was a "diamond" type shape with it being more round at the top.
